desc: Derive and justify the bottleneck characterization and stair-cost formula, including endpoint and same-building cases.
Design the maximum spanning/Kruskal reconstruction tree and verify that LCA weights equal maximum bottleneck levels.
Specify efficient preprocessing and per-query LCA implementation within the constraints.
Implement input parsing, grid-edge generation, DSU/Kruskal construction, ancestor tables, query evaluation, and memory-conscious output.
